notes.title: Small Post Launch Updates
notes.content:
I've released a few small patches since the game launched. Here's a list:
[list]
[*]Fixed an out of bounds area in the air level
[*]Fixed the space level teleporting you to the corner after beating it
[*] Added stairs to the volcano level so players don't get pushed into the lava
[*] Buffed the grenade launcher
[*] Made the left building on the firefly town easier to jump on
[*] Destroyed the left wall of the ghost house for easier entrance
[*] Fixed a bug with the fish where they could jump out of bounds if you had a high enough fps
[*] Fixed a bug where you can lose the ball to the baseball bat if you hit it to the left during a level transition
[*] Created a infinite mode leaderboard
[b]Probably the biggest ones of all:[/b]
[*]Replaced the dance party enemy with a new one that shoots rockets that follow Stick Knight
[*] Remade the gear/mechanical level
[/list]

If you find any bugs or have any feedback, you can contact me through a discussion post, at my email woodadam272@gmail.com, or via DM on Twitter (@StickKnight1)
